title: RegistryManifest
description: The set of loadable models and which one is active by default. The ml-service loads this at startup and switches the active model by id. Contract shape from spec 0001 Feature design.

schema_version.description: Contract version. A breaking change bumps it.

default_model_id.description: The model_id active at startup. Must appear in models.

model_id.description: Stable id used to switch the active model at runtime.

display_name.description: Human readable name for the UI.

family.description: Model family. Drives score semantics: the tree supports predict_proba, the SVMs do not.

path.description: Path to the joblib artifact (scaler plus model bundled).

supports_proba.description: True if the model exposes predict_proba (the tree). False for the SVMs.

metrics.description: The v1 held out metrics from notebook 07_comparison.

recall.description: Detection rate on the malicious class.
